title: Eccovi, o caro amico
subtitle: Marcellina, Bartolo, Susanna and Figaro: recitative from Le nozze di Figaro, Act 3

facts.tempo: Recitative, free, then Andante a tempo at ♩ = 72

note: Bartolo agrees to marry Marcellina at last
about: Score: the recitative “Eccovi, o caro amico” (vocal score pages 245-246, 19 bars), from Paul Klengel's piano reduction in the Breitkopf & Härtel vocal score (Edition Breitkopf 1716, about 1900), public domain.
